title: Remake pipeline hygiene: output tails, backendFrozen on verify, scoped git add, ignores
goal: The remake pipeline stores the END of failing gate output (where the cause is), blocks verify jobs from editing the backend, never commits test artefacts, and can mark jobs resolved.
context: Before editing, read desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3 (executor rules), 4 (worktree bootstrap + runtime stack) and 5 (gates), and desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md. Bug details (symptom, repro, evidence) for every id below are in desktop/audit/fix/bugs.json and BUGS.md. scripts/remake-pipeline.js (1264 lines): helpers head()/tail() at lines 141-142; state.json error stored as `String(error).slice(0, 300)` (line 170); gate output trimmed with `.slice(0, 1500)` (~385) and printed with the first 8 lines (~406) - repair runs never saw the real failure (showcase: session expiry happened first). Job definitions with gates arrays at ~267, ~290, ~317 - identify which is the verify job and ensure it includes 'backendFrozen' (verify jobs made ~29 unapproved backend changes). Find every `git add` and scope it to the job's paths (never commit test-results/, playwright-report/, .wrangler*). desktop/.gitignore already has test-results/; root .gitignore needs repo-wide patterns.
steps: Replace head-based trimming of gate output/errors with tail-based trimming (last ~60 lines / 4000 chars) in state.json writes and console summaries (lines ~170, ~385, ~406 and any similar).
Add 'backendFrozen' to the verify job gates (and any other non-backend job type that lacks it).
Scope git add: stage only the job's allowlisted paths (or desktop/ + docs for UI jobs) and explicitly exclude **/test-results/**, **/playwright-report/**, backend/.wrangler*/, *.webm/*.zip artefacts.
Add CLI `--mark-ok <jobId> [--note "..."]` that sets a job's state to ok with the note and timestamp (used by B31 for verify:travellers, cleanup, showcase) if no equivalent exists.
Root .gitignore: add `**/test-results/`, `**/playwright-report/`, `backend/.wrangler-e2e.toml`, `backend/.wrangler-test.toml` (check what is already present).
Validate: `node --check scripts/remake-pipeline.js`; run its status/help mode (no agents launched) and a dry `--mark-ok` against a copy of state.json in your scratchpad.
acceptance: --mark-ok works on a scratch copy of state.json.
